leads.roleSpecificEvidence: 3-Ci Manufacturing is a Calgary manufacturer of custom overmolded cable assemblies, connectors and precision-machined components for rugged industrial, aerospace, defence and uncrewed-system applications. 3-Ci designs and manufactures custom overmolded cable assemblies, connectors and wiring systems intended for harsh environments, including defence, UAV and USV applications. PrairiesCan lists 3-Ci Manufacturing as a 2026 Regional Defence Investment Initiative recipient expanding production capacity for military-grade cable and wiring systems.

leads.roleSpecificEvidence: Canadian UAVs is a Calgary remotely piloted aircraft company providing fixed-wing and multi-rotor drone systems, beyond-visual-line-of-sight operations and aerial-intelligence services for commercial and military applications. Canadian UAVs provides deployable remotely piloted aircraft and intelligence services designed for long-endurance, beyond-visual-line-of-sight reconnaissance and situational-awareness operations. PrairiesCan's 2026 RDII backgrounder identifies Canadian UAVs' project to deliver a deployable drone platform and intelligence suite for defence and security reconnaissance and situational awareness.

leads.roleSpecificEvidence: Microlynx Systems is a Calgary electronics and software-development company that develops high-frequency transmitter, amplification, filtering and control systems for over-the-horizon radar applications. Microlynx's M4000 system integrates waveform generation, high-power amplification, filtering, communications and control for high-frequency over-the-horizon radar transmit sites. PrairiesCan's 2026 RDII backgrounder identifies Microlynx's project to improve high-power RF amplifiers supporting Polar Over the Horizon Radar and Arctic domain awareness.
